info.title: CoffeeFlix
info.author: Roastedd
info.description: YouTube, Jellyfin, Twitch, radio, podcasts and your own media
info.details:
YouTube, Jellyfin, Twitch, internet radio, podcasts and your own videos, music, photos and books in one fast app made for the TV and the GamePad. No accounts, no ads, nothing to set up.

YouTube without an account: a For you feed that learns what you like on the console itself, subscriptions with a newest-first feed (import them from Google Takeout or NewPipe), channel pages with videos, Shorts, live streams and playlists, Watch later, history, captions, and sponsor skipping with SponsorBlock.
Jellyfin: continue watching, next up, seasons and episodes, subtitles, and resume that syncs back to your server. Sign in with Quick Connect.
Twitch: live channels, categories, search and a follow list.
Radio: over 40,000 stations from radio-browser.info.
Podcasts: the Apple Podcasts directory and top charts, with subscriptions and resume.
My Media: videos, music, photos, comics (CBZ) and EPUB books from the SD card, network shares (SMB) and DLNA media servers.

Hardware H.264 decoding, up to 720p on YouTube and 1080p for your own files. Works with the GamePad, Pro Controller, Wii Remote and touch.

Free for noncommercial use. Website: https://roastedd.github.io/CoffeeFlix/
